title.narrative: PROMOTE DECENT WORK, RIGHTS AND DIGNITY FOR DOMESTIC WORKERS (emPoWeRD)

description.narrative: The ‘Promote Decent Work, Rights and Dignity for Domestic Workers (emPoWeRD)’ in Ethiopia and Tanzania, aims to increase the quality of life of local and migrant Domestic Workers (DWs) in Ethiopia and Tanzania, aims to promote dignity and confidence, and to obtain decent working conditions within a recognised legal framework., together with implementing partners CVM Italy, CHODAWU, and ECC-SDCO. The objectives of the grant are to Increase the voice and role of CSOs representing DWs in policy dialogue, strengthen the capacity of DWs CSOs on the extent to negotiate with employers for decent conditions, and promote safe migration in all the phases of the migration cycle. The key activities include the training of employers on creating conditions for decent work conditions, creation of DW associations or Trade Unions, and awareness campaigns to promote DW’s rights and safe migration. National Multi-stakeholders Conference and Task Force are convened to address the issues of DWs legislations, contracts and working conditions.
